pyqs.independentSolution: Use chemistry sign w positive on gas: forward ΔU=10−18=−8 J. Reverse ΔU=+8 J, q=−6 J. w=8−(−6)=14 J. Whole-cycle check q=4 J and w=−4 J, total zero.

pyqs.answer: Statement I false; Statement II true under heat absorbed by gas interpretation
pyqs.independentSolution: For ideal gas with only pressure-volume work, Cp=Cv+R, so Cv>Cp is false. At fixed volume w=0, so absorbed heat raises U and T. Original says heat withdrawn without naming its source; adaptation explicitly says heat absorbed by the gas, the meaning consistent with the keyed true second statement. This wording clarification is disclosed; no claim that heat removed from gas raises temperature.

targetQuestionText: A gas goes from state X to state Y, absorbing 10 J of heat and doing 18 J of work. It returns to X by another path and releases 6 J of heat. How much work is done on or by the gas on the return path?
